summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation filed a routine Form 6-K notice to shareholders regarding the third installment of a dividend approved at its April 22, 2026 Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders' Meeting. The installment totals US$18,688,330.25, paying US$0.019991920777278 per subscribed, paid and entitled share in cash in Mexican pesos through S.D. Indeval on October 15, 2026, using the Bank of Mexico exchange rate published October 14, 2026. This is an ordinary capital distribution notice, not a special situation; no special-situation deal terms, board recommendation or advisor are stated.
